requiredBehaviors.behavior: classify the event as an evidence-only lifecycle change and route it to clinical evidence impact assessment before assuming a technical design change
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill explicitly recognizes evidence-only events and routes new clinical evidence to clinical-evidence-update-impact without requiring a technical product modification.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep any later design, label, risk or submission work conditional on specialist evidence-impact conclusions
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Routing is separated from impact decisions and downstream work is represented as specialist-owned gates and next actions rather than automatic change implementation.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: force every regulatory lifecycle event through design change assessment
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The event taxonomy distinguishes new clinical evidence, PMS signals and regulatory/guidance changes from design or product changes.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: create a product release gate for an event that has not yet produced a confirmed product modification
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The workflow only aggregates gates that arise from specialist decisions; it does not infer a release gate merely from an evidence-only event.
